# skycloak_cluster_private_link (Resource)

Manages Azure private link for a cluster. Only one resource should manage a cluster's private link. Requires an Enterprise plan with private networking and a site that supports Azure private link. Destroy disables private link and keeps the subscription IDs and hostnames. Restore public access before destroying this resource; the API refuses to disable private link while public access is off. The API key needs `clusters:private-link:read` and `clusters:private-link:write` scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an Enterprise plan and a cluster on a site with Azure private link.
resource "skycloak_cluster_private_link" "example" {
  cluster_id             = skycloak_cluster.example.id
  enabled                = true
  azure_subscription_ids = ["11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"]

  # Optional: bare hosts you reach the cluster on through your own proxy or DNS.
  hostnames = ["auth.example.com"]
}

output "private_link_alias" {
  value = skycloak_cluster_private_link.example.alias
}

# Restore public access before destroying this resource if it is off.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `azure_subscription_ids` (Set of String) Azure subscription IDs allowed to connect, as lowercase GUIDs (at most 20). At least one is required when enabled. An empty set clears the stored IDs.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Azure private link is enabled.

### Optional

- `hostnames` (Set of String) Hostnames you reach the cluster on through your own proxy or DNS, as bare hosts: no scheme, port, path, query or credentials (at most 5). A host must be a DNS name with at least two labels. IP addresses, `localhost`, Skycloak domains and hosts another workspace already uses are refused. Write each host in lowercase with no surrounding spaces; other forms are refused at plan time. Removing this attribute clears the stored hostnames. They stay stored while private link is disabled.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) Private Link Service alias to use when creating an Azure private endpoint. Null when disabled or not yet available.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/private-link`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skycloak_cluster_private_link.example 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
